hold_reasoning: No trade: the binding constraint is funding, not conviction. Investable cash is 71.29 EUR (221.29 less the 150 floor) against a 250-400 EUR band, and the book holds 6 real positions against a 6 cap, so any entry needs a funding sale first - and no held thesis is breaking. BTC-EUR is held by both crypto desks (yolo-sapiens-eur 8/10, satoshi 6/10); goldfinger is constructive on both metals lines I own; AIR.PA and NVDA are uncovered but supported, not contradicted, by world's crude-down read and sharp-shooter-usd's semis breakout. Seven of ten analysts are hold or reduce. The three buy-biased notes are all conviction 7, and two gate on levels that have not printed (goldfinger needs PHAG.L over 63.15, verified 60.13 USD; sharp-shooter-eur needs KNIN.SW OVER 231.20 and the verified close is exactly 231.20 - touched, not cleared). yolo-sapiens-usd's HBAR is the one clean untaken setup, but its own stop at 0.0851 is 14% below spot, it is pure alt beta stacked on an already-maximal BTC position whose break case is 'BTC rolls and drags the complex', and at 71 EUR the 1.25 IBIE floor alone is ~3.5% round-trip - it fails the 2x cost test before the thesis is judged. No conditional order either: a trigger still needs cash at fire time, and 71 EUR cannot fund one. On the risk-budget check (rule 4): BTC-EUR at 414.00 EUR is over the nominal 400 cap but is 20.0% of the actual 2,068.73 EUR book, inside the 25% the cap is defined as. I decline to trim - recovering 14 EUR would realise ~3.2 EUR of a +29.3% gain and, more importantly, fire a full-portfolio PVCT crypto snapshot for a 14 EUR disposal, which is precisely the taxable event the policy says to batch and defer, against two desks holding the position. On the 7th line: SLB is a 0.0034-share stub worth 0.15 EUR left by Monday's exit. It is above the 1e-9 dust epsilon so it counts as a position, but clearing it costs the 1.25 EUR fee floor - 8x its value - to free a slot nothing can currently fund. It gets swept alongside the next genuine funding sale rather than paid for on its own. Cash floor and position cap are both effectively restored; conviction 7 is above the gate, and the gate is not what is stopping me.
